extra_vocab.en: a large ship or plane that carries goods, not passengers
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 the freighter Nordic Star 指載運四十台發電機從漢堡到港口的貨輪。freighter 專指運貨的船或飛機，比 ship 更明確。

example.en: Several freighters were waiting outside the port because of the strong winds.
example.zh: 因為強風，好幾艘貨輪在港外等候。

example.en: An ocean freighter takes about three weeks to cross the Pacific.
example.zh: 遠洋貨輪橫越太平洋約需三個星期。

example.en: Urgent spare parts will be sent by air freighter tonight.
example.zh: 緊急的備用零件今晚會用貨機送出。

example.en: Workers need two full days to load a freighter this size.
example.zh: 工人需要整整兩天才能裝完這種大小的貨輪。

examples.en: The freighter will arrive at the port on Thursday morning.
examples.zh: 貨輪將在星期四早上抵達港口。

examples.en: Your order left the factory aboard a freighter last week.
examples.zh: 您的訂單上週已搭乘貨輪離開工廠。

examples.en: A freighter carrying electronics was delayed by a storm at sea.
examples.zh: 一艘載運電子產品的貨輪被海上風暴耽誤。

confusable.diff: ferry 是載人與車輛的渡輪，freighter 是專門載貨的貨輪。

example.en: Staff take the ferry to the island office every morning.
example.zh: 員工每天早上搭渡輪到島上的辦公室。

similar.diff: cargo ship 是較通用的說法，只能指船；freighter 也可指貨機。

example.en: A large cargo ship delivered the steel to our factory.
example.zh: 一艘大型貨輪把鋼材運到我們的工廠。

similar.diff: container ship 專門裝貨櫃，是 freighter 的一種。

example.en: The container ship holds more than ten thousand containers.
example.zh: 這艘貨櫃船可裝超過一萬個貨櫃。

example.en: The vessel reached the harbor two hours ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 這艘船比預定時間早兩小時抵達港口。

example.en: All cargo must be inspected before it leaves the dock.
example.zh: 所有貨物離開碼頭前都必須檢查。

example.en: The next shipment is expected to arrive on Monday.
example.zh: 下一批貨預計星期一抵達。

derived.link: freighter 的詞幹，freight 是「貨運」；加 -er 變成「運貨的東西」，像 computer、printer

senses.en: a large ship that carries goods across the sea
senses.distinguish: 文中有 aboard、port、vessel，可判斷是船。

example.en: The freighter docked at Kaohsiung Port at dawn.
example.zh: 貨輪在黎明時靠泊高雄港。

senses.en: a plane that carries goods instead of passengers
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 air 或 cargo，或情境提到機場。

example.en: The freighter lands at the airport every night at eleven.
example.zh: 這架貨機每晚十一點降落在機場。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡出現在主旨 Update on the Generator Shipment，指進口的四十台工業用發電機。商業信件的主旨常用名詞片語，所以 Generator 首字母大寫。

example.en: Both generators were tested before they were sent to the plant.
example.zh: 兩台發電機在送往工廠前都經過測試。

example.en: The hospital switched to its backup generator during the blackout.
example.zh: 停電期間醫院改用備用發電機。

example.en: A diesel generator supplies power to the construction site.
example.zh: 柴油發電機為工地供電。

example.en: We rented a portable generator for the outdoor event.
example.zh: 我們為戶外活動租了一台可攜式發電機。

examples.en: We need to order three new generators before the summer season.
examples.zh: 夏季之前我們需要訂購三台新的發電機。

examples.en: The factory cannot run without a generator during a power failure.
examples.zh: 停電時，工廠沒有發電機就無法運轉。

examples.en: Please confirm the delivery date for the industrial generator.
examples.zh: 請確認這台工業用發電機的交貨日期。

confusable.diff: generator 是「發電機、產生器」，generation 是「世代」或「產生、發電的過程」。
confusable.usage: generator 指機器，可數；generation 指世代或過程，兩者詞尾不同，不能互換。

example.en: The new generation of engineers prefers cleaner power sources.
example.zh: 新一代的工程師偏好更乾淨的能源。

similar.diff: power plant 是供應大量電力的發電廠；generator 是單一機器。

example.en: The new power plant will supply electricity to the whole city.
example.zh: 新的發電廠將為整個城市供電。

example.en: The engine needs regular maintenance every six months.
example.zh: 引擎每六個月需要定期保養。

example.en: The motor stopped working after the power surge.
example.zh: 電力突波後馬達就停止運轉了。

example.en: The battery lasts about ten hours on a full charge.
example.zh: 這個電池充滿電可用約十小時。

derived.link: generator 的詞幹，generate 是「產生」；加 -or 變成「產生的機器」，像 operator
generate 去掉 -e 加 -ion 變名詞，像 create → creation

senses.distinguish: 文中有 industrial、assembly line，指的是實體機器。

example.en: The generator provides power when the main supply fails.
example.zh: 主電源中斷時，發電機提供電力。

senses.en: a tool or program that makes something automatically
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 report、password 等字，指軟體工具。

example.en: Use the report generator to create the monthly sales summary.
example.zh: 用報表產生器製作每月銷售摘要。

extra_vocab.en: very important and needing action right now
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 it is imperative that this discrepancy be corrected 表示「這個差異一定要在星期五前更正」，語氣比 important 強，帶有緊迫感，適合在報告中向主管強調急迫性。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: it is imperative that 後面的 that 子句用原形動詞（可加 should），不隨主詞變化，如 it is imperative that he be present；也可接 to V。

example.en: It is imperative that every shipment be checked before departure.
example.zh: 每批貨在出發前都必須檢查，這一點絕對必要。

example.en: It is imperative to back up all files before the upgrade.
example.zh: 升級之前務必備份所有檔案。

example.en: Cutting costs has become a business imperative for the company.
example.zh: 削減成本已成為公司的當務之急。

examples.en: It is imperative that we receive the payment before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們必須在截止日前收到款項。

examples.en: Safety training is imperative for everyone working on the factory floor.
examples.zh: 安全訓練對在工廠現場工作的每個人都是必要的。

examples.en: It is imperative to report any equipment problem to your supervisor.
examples.zh: 任何設備問題都務必向主管回報。

confusable.diff: imperial 是形容詞，意思是「帝國的」或「英制的」，和 imperative 只是拼法相近。

example.en: The old factory still uses imperial units for all measurements.
example.zh: 這間老工廠的所有測量仍使用英制單位。

similar.diff: essential 強調「不可缺少」，imperative 強調「急迫、必須馬上處理」。

example.en: Clear communication is essential when we manage a large project.
example.zh: 管理大型專案時，清楚的溝通不可或缺。

similar.diff: crucial 強調對結果「關鍵」，imperative 強調「必須採取行動」。

example.en: The next two weeks are crucial for the product launch.
example.zh: 接下來兩週對產品上市至關重要。

example.en: I need an urgent reply to the customer's complaint.
example.zh: 我需要儘快回覆這位顧客的客訴。

example.en: Accurate records are vital for every customs filing.
example.zh: 準確的紀錄對每次報關都至關重要。

example.en: Is it necessary to resend the whole document?
example.zh: 有必要重寄整份文件嗎？

example.en: It is imperative that we confirm the order today.
example.zh: 我們今天一定要確認這筆訂單。

example.en: Customer safety is the first imperative for any airline.
example.zh: 顧客安全是任何航空公司的首要之務。

extra_vocab.en: careful because you think something bad may happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 we remain cautious 表示雖然供應商回應很快，但第二次檢查的風險還在，所以團隊不敢掉以輕心。語氣是理性、保留的專業用語。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: cautious 常接 about + 名詞／V-ing 或 of + 名詞，如 be cautious about signing；不要寫成 cautious to sign。

example.en: The bank takes a cautious approach when it approves large loans.
example.zh: 銀行核准大額貸款時採取謹慎的做法。

example.en: Investors showed cautious optimism after the quarterly results came out.
example.zh: 季報公布後，投資人表現出審慎樂觀。

example.en: We should be cautious about promising an exact delivery date.
example.zh: 我們對承諾確切的交貨日期應該要謹慎。

examples.en: The board is cautious about expanding into a new market this year.
examples.zh: 董事會對今年拓展新市場態度謹慎。

examples.en: We remain cautious until the supplier sends the signed contract.
examples.zh: 在供應商寄來簽署的合約之前，我們仍保持謹慎。

examples.en: Cautious investors prefer safe options with steady returns.
examples.zh: 謹慎的投資人偏好報酬穩定的安全選項。

confusable.diff: conscious 是「意識到的、有意識的」，發音和 cautious 相近，但意思不是「小心」。
confusable.usage: conscious 常用 be conscious of，表示「察覺到」；cautious 常用 be cautious about，表示「對…小心」。

example.en: We are conscious of the problem and are working on a fix.
example.zh: 我們已意識到這個問題，正在處理修正。

similar.diff: careful 是日常的「小心」，cautious 更強調為了避免風險而保守、不冒險。

example.en: Please be careful when you move the heavy equipment.
example.zh: 搬運重型設備時請小心。

similar.diff: wary 帶有「不信任、有戒心」的意思，後面常接 of。

example.en: Customers are wary of offers that sound too good to be true.
example.zh: 顧客對好得不像真的優惠心存戒心。

example.en: A careful review can prevent costly mistakes.
example.zh: 仔細的檢查可以避免代價高昂的錯誤。

example.en: The manager is wary of changing suppliers so late.
example.zh: 經理對這麼晚才更換供應商有所戒心。

example.en: It is prudent to keep some money in reserve.
example.zh: 保留一些備用資金是明智的。

derived.link: cautious 的詞幹，caution 是「小心」；加 -ous 變形容詞，像 nervous、serious
cautious + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 careful → carefully
